rules.match: PowerShell parser, quoting, encoding, or parameter binding failure
rules.preflight: Write an independent UTF-8 .ps1 and invoke it with pwsh.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -File.
Check session status and remote actual state; never replay an uncertain deployment command.
Stop before service mutation and refresh the reviewed manifest against the live target.

rules.match: Global deployment mutex is already owned
rules.preflight: Report the collision and do not retry or stop another deployment.

rules.match: New static file is installed but the browser still shows the old behavior
rules.preflight: Change the asset version query and verify through a cache-busted URL or new browser context.
